reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the 1–10 person business owner-operator in Bareni's calm, pragmatic founder voice, respecting the no-CTA brief.
reasons.clarity: Logical, clean progression from viewing weekly rhythms as a constraint to a clear diagnostic filter, written in plain language.
reasons.actionability: Provides a practical diagnostic method to evaluate whether a recurring workflow is fit for automation while keeping human oversight.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no unsupported performance claims, invented customer stories, or inflated capability statements.
